requirements.statement: The framework release shall include an AuditHunt installation profile that maps reusable framework modules and adapters without importing AuditHunt implementation or history.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: The profile shall not claim AuditHunt facts, modify AuditHunt, certify AuditHunt, or expose restricted AuditHunt evidence; all project-specific state remains externally supplied and verified.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: Installation shall be reversible, profile-scoped, versioned, and validated against an explicitly provided AuditHunt baseline in a separate authorized program.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability
